description: This file contains unit tests for sandbox-tool-policy-related functions such as pickSandboxToolPolicy and resolveEffectiveToolPolicy, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: pickSandboxToolPolicy
methods.description: Determines the sandbox tool policy based on configuration inputs, supporting allow, deny, and alsoAllow parameters.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the effective tool policy considering global configurations and agent-specific settings.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolFsRootExpansionAllowed
methods.description: Determines if expansion of the file system root is allowed based on configuration.

ctags.name: resolved
ctags.pattern: /^    const resolved = resolveEffectiveToolPolicy({ config: cfg, agentId: "main" });$/
